title: Initialize productdb in CI through the existing migration runner
decision: The integration job runs `go run . migrate` with its explicit disposable productdb DATABASE_URL before integration tests. The command reuses the application's embedded golang-migrate mechanism and exits without starting the HTTP server; the productdb test URL guard and isolated-schema harness remain unchanged.
rationale: The safe integration harness reads the public root sentinel before creating its isolated schema, so a freshly provisioned CI database must first receive migrations and the root seed. Reusing the existing migration mechanism avoids a second migration implementation and keeps schema state consistent with application startup.
risk: The workflow uses disposable service-container credentials already present in CI; no production credentials or fallback database URL is introduced. The migration command can be invoked manually, so operators must provide an explicitly intended DATABASE_URL.
